title: Sr. Software Engineer, Kernels/CUDA (C++)
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

SR. SOFTWARE ENGINEER, KERNELS/CUDA (C++)

We are building one of the world’s largest AI supercomputers from the ground up. As part of the Compute Infrastructure team, you will own both the raw GPU supercomputer and the platform layer that runs on top of it. You will work across the full stack - from low-level GPU kernel optimizations and Linux kernel internals to massive-scale orchestration and virtualization - to make training and inference at SpaceXSI as fast, reliable, and scalable as possible.
This is a broad, high-impact role that combines hardcore supercompute and compute infrastructure work. Your contributions will directly accelerate Grok’s training speed and overall AI progress.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Design, build, and optimize massive GPU clusters for extreme-scale training and inference workloads

• Develop and tune low-level CUDA kernels (GeMM, Attention, etc.), using CUTLASS, Tensor Cores, and Nsight for maximum performance

• Profile, debug, and eliminate bottlenecks across GPU memory hierarchy, networking fabric, filesystems, and multi-GPU operation

• Collaborate closely with AI research teams to deliver production-grade performance and scalability

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• 5+ years of experience with low-level system programming in C/C++

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Deep low-level systems programming (C/C++/PTX/SASS)

• Strong experience with large-scale GPU clusters or distributed compute infrastructure at production scale

• Hands-on work with GPU kernel optimization (CUTLASS, custom kernels, Nsight profiling)

• Track record of building or running high-performance infrastructure for AI workloads (training or inference platforms)

• Ability to reason from first principles and optimize for both memory-bound and compute-bound scenarios

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

$200,000 - $375,000 USD

Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.

description:
Who we are ?
Télécom Paris, part of the IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) and a founding member of the Institut Polytechnique de Paris, is one of France's top 6 general engineering schools.
The mainspring of Télécom Paris is to train, imagine and undertake to design digital models, technologies and solutions for a society and economy that respect people and their environment.

Modern distributed systems are increasingly complex, with multiple interconnected components, services, and autonomous agents interacting in dynamic environments. Ensuring their cybersecurity requires analysing both potential attacks and the strategies that defenders can adopt in response. Attackers may exploit sequences of vulnerabilities to compromise a system, while defenders may react through countermeasures such as access restrictions, system reconfigurations, or Moving Target Defense mechanisms. Traditional cybersecurity analysis techniques often focus on identifying vulnerabilities and possible attack paths, with limited support for reasoning about the strategic interactions between attackers and defenders.
The VITAMIN-C (VerIficaTion of A MultI-ageNt system for Cybersecurity) project aims to address these challenges through formal verification. Building on VITAMIN, an existing modular model-checking platform for multi-agent systems, the project develops methods and tools for modelling and verifying cybersecurity properties in distributed and autonomous systems. Attackers and defenders are represented as agents with specific capabilities, objectives, and available actions. Their interactions are analysed using attack graphs, temporal and strategic logics, and model-checking techniques. This approach allows the verification of security properties, such as the preservation of confidentiality and integrity, as well as the synthesis of defensive strategies against known attack scenarios.
A central challenge of the project concerns the scalability of formal verification when applied to realistic cybersecurity scenarios. To address this issue, VITAMIN-C investigates symbolic and abstract model-checking techniques, together with a modular architecture supporting the integration of different verification engines.
Within this context, the R&D engineer will contribute to the design, implementation, and evaluation of formal verification techniques for VITAMIN-C. The work will focus on formal modelling of cybersecurity scenarios, strategic model checking, development and optimisation of verification algorithms, and their integration into the existing platform. The engineer will also participate in experimental evaluations using cybersecurity benchmarks and industrial use cases, contributing to the development of a practical verification tool.

Your main responsibilities will include :

• Carry out R&D work in formal methods and cybersecurity verification

The candidate must have a sound knowledge of formal methods, transition systems, verification algorithms and software development. They must be able to design, test and document research software in a collaborative environment, and have a good command of English.
Skills in temporal or strategic logic, model checking, symbolic methods, SAT/SMT and multi-agent systems would be an advantage. Experience in cybersecurity, attack graphs, Python/C++ programming, Docker or distributed systems would also be an asset.

About Us

Rho is the modern banking platform built for the AI era. Startups and growth-stage companies can open accounts in minutes, issue cards, manage expenses, pay bills, and close the books - all in one connected platform backed by real human support.

The Role

The best products grow because people can't stop using them and can't help telling others about them.

We want Rho to grow because of the product. Every founder who uses Rho pays vendors, issues cards to their team, and invites people in. Every one of those moments is someone meeting Rho for the first time, and a chance to bring in the next customer. Your job is to make the most of every one.

We're hiring a Growth PM to own how Rho grows through the product itself, from the first time someone hears about us to the moment Rho becomes their bank. That means three things:

1. Get founders into the funnel. Grow the top of the funnel through referrals, network effects and every place Rho already touches.

2. Get them through sign up. Work closely with your partners across product to make getting approved fast and painless.

3. Get them fully onboarded. Make sure they actually switch banks and start using everything Rho can do, not just open an account.

What you'd own

- The growth strategy, not just the features. Define the bets, the channels and the metrics that drive our next stage of growth, and be accountable for the number.

- A referral engine founders love to use. Make referring Rho effortless and a little bit fun, then keep making it better.

- Network effects across every edge. Vendors who get paid, employees who get cards, payees, and accountants all touch Rho. Turn each of those into a reason to sign up.

- The top of the funnel, in partnership with marketing. Work hand in hand with our marketing team on acquisition, conversion and where we invest.

- Activation, all the way through. Get founders past sign up and into the product. Get them to switch banks, issue cards, pay their first bill, and run their business all on Rho.

- Unconventional bets. Some of the best growth ideas won't look like product work. Bring them anyway.

Who you are

You've done this before: at least 5 years in product, with real growth or product led acquisition work you can point to and a number you moved.

You are the kind of person who:

- Thinks in loops, not funnels. You see how one customer brings in the next and design for that.

- Has strong product judgment and taste. Growth tactics that cheapen the product aren't wins. You find the ones that make it better.

- Lives in the data. You size the opportunity, set the metric, run the experiment and know whether it worked.

- Moves fast. You ship something real, learn from it, and ship again.

- Uses AI to do more with less. Not just for your own work, but to build systems that let a small team grow a big business.

- Partners well. Marketing, design, engineering, sales, post sales and support all touch growth. You bring them along.

Who this isn't for

- Marketers who want to stay in marketing. This is a product role. You'll be building, not running campaigns.

- Feature PMs looking for a change of scenery. Growth is its own craft. We need someone who already loves it.

- Anyone who needs a fully formed roadmap handed to them. You'll write it.

The bar

We're building the best business banking platform in the world for founders. If you're already thinking about how you'd get every vendor we pay to become a customer, we should talk.

Our people are our most valuable asset. Our target compensation range for this role is $165,000 - $320,000. Compensation will be determined by leveling and performance throughout the interview process. In addition to base pay, Rho offers equity, comprehensive healthcare benefits, and paid time off.

title: Senior Social Media Manager
description:
We are seeking an innovative, data-backed Personal Brand Manager to oversee and expand a multi-channel online footprint. In this role, you will lead end-to-end digital media initiatives-from concept through execution-combining strategic vision with hands-on production. The ideal candidate thrives at the intersection of creative storytelling, modern content technology, and performance analysis, driving audience expansion and deepening brand affinity across established and emerging channels.
Duties / Task to perform

•
Social Media & Content Strategy: Develop and manage a consistent content calendar for LinkedIn and Instagram, aligning content with brand messaging and lead generation goals. Turn completed projects, services, and business capabilities into engaging social posts, case studies, website content, and visual assets.

•
Search Engine Optimization (SEO): Manage and optimize the Google Business Profile to improve local search visibility and engagement. Conduct SEO and keyword research to identify content opportunities, ranking improvements, and optimization needs.

•
Website & Landing Page Management: Coordinate updates to website content, landing pages, and project pages to support organic visibility and lead capture.

•
Prospecting & Lead Research: Research and qualify potential B2B prospects, including contractors, developers, property managers, architects, and other relevant decision-makers. Research and track relevant public and private bid opportunities, project announcements, and potential business opportunities.

•
Email Marketing & Prospecting: Support targeted email marketing campaigns for prospecting, lead acquisition, and lead nurturing.

•
Asset Creation: Create and edit digital assets using tools such as Canva and basic photo/video editing platforms.

•
Performance Tracking & CRM Management: Monitor digital marketing performance across social media, search, website, email, and lead generation activities. Maintain accurate lead and opportunity information within CRM and tracking systems.

•
Analytics & Reporting: Prepare concise performance reports and provide actionable insights based on campaign and channel results. Proactively recommend improvements to digital marketing and lead generation activities based on performance data.

•
Market Intelligence: Conduct competitor and market research to identify emerging opportunities, tactics, and digital channels.

Requirements

•
Experience: 3+ years of professional digital marketing experience, with a strong focus on B2B lead generation.

•
Social Media Proficiency: Proven experience managing professional LinkedIn and Instagram accounts and developing content for these platforms.

•
SEO & Analytics Tools: Solid knowledge of SEO principles, Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and Google Business Profile optimization.

•
B2B Research: Experience conducting prospect research and identifying qualified B2B leads and business opportunities.

•
Content & Tech Stack: Proficiency with content creation tools such as Canva and basic photo/video editing software. Experience with CRM and email marketing platforms such as HubSpot, Mailchimp, Constant Contact, or similar tools.

•
Analytical & Communication Skills: Strong research and analytical skills with the ability to interpret marketing data and identify actionable improvements. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, including persuasive marketing copywriting.

•
Self-Management: Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities independently. Proactive, self-directed approach and ability to work effectively in a remote environment.

•
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, or a related field preferred.

•
Technical Setup: Reliable internet connection and a suitable remote workspace.

Schedule: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM-5:00 PM (PST).
